attchmntText: Venky's (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Venky’s India Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 16th November 2026. The company reported good financial performance for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 compared to the previous year. The Poultry and Poultry Products segment performed well due to better realizations despite seasonal demand fluctuations. The Animal Health Products segment showed satisfactory performance. The Oilseed segment profitability was negatively impacted by sharp increases in soya seed prices in July and August, followed by a sudden fall in September. Cash and cash equivalents stood at INR112.69 crores as of 30th September 2026. Management noted that maize prices have risen significantly, leading to higher production costs, but expects chicken and egg prices to adjust upward over time to reflect these increased input costs.

voiceSummary: Venky’s India Limited has provided a link to the audio recording of its investor call held on 16 November 2026. The call discussed financials for the year ended 30 September 2026. The company references scrip codes 523261 for BSE Limited and VENKEYS for NSE Limited. The announcement was issued by Rohan Bhagwat, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Venky's (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Updated Investor Information.
voiceSummary: Venky’s operates a three-segment business comprising Poultry Products, Animal Health, and Oilseeds. The Poultry segment generates approximately fifty percent of revenue, while Oilseeds contribute forty percent and Animal Health ten percent. The company maintains a zero-term-debt status, funded by internal accruals. A new manufacturing unit in Kesurdi commenced production in March 2024 with an investment of approximately INR 67 Crores, aiming to double capacity. Financial highlights for the five-year period show Profit After Tax of 16,478 Lakhs in the most recent year. Shareholding as of 30th September 2026 indicates Promoters hold 56.11 percent and the Public holds 36.75 percent. The company focuses on operational efficiency through improved Feed Conversion Ratio to manage commodity cost volatility.
